evidence: Sen. Ep. 92.21: frīgidum aliquid et calidum nōvimus: inter utrumque tepidum est (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Between cold and hot, as Seneca explains; of water, milk or a bath. tepēre is to be lukewarm, tepefacere to make so.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 404.
